source: http://www.millershapes.com (official model pages — excludes clothing, ding repair, and generic custom-only categories)

brands.name: Miller Surfboards
brands.short_description: Josh Miller shapes custom hand-shaped and 3DM CAD surfboards from Atlantic Beach, Florida.

models.name: Phantom
models.description: Missing link between your standard shortboard and your fish.  Ride the phantom 3-4 inches shorter than your normal shortboard.  Board has Fuller outline more volume, combined with a moderate single to double concave.  Quad+1 set up.

models.name: Red Label
models.description: Enhanced volume, single to double concave.  Thruster set up.  Slightly more volume than your standard shortboard. Available in round-squash or swallow tail

models.name: Black Label
models.description: Enhanced volume, single to double concave, and a quad+1 fin set up makes this board a very good all around board. Available in round-squash or swallow tail.

models.name: Gut Wagon
models.description: Short wide and thick. , Low rocker with a single to double concave with V off the tail. Board is a wave catching machine!  Best to order 4-6 inches shorter than your normal shortboard. . Available in round-squash or swallow tail,or rocket tail.

models.name: Zero
models.description: Low entry rocker with double to panel v out the tail. Board is a super versatile small wave board.  That comes as a Quad+1

models.name: M-1
models.description: Fuller outline, wider tail block, all around more volume, combined with a moderate single to double concave makes this board a good groveler.  Best in knee to head high surf

models.name: M-2
models.description: High performance go to shortboard for experienced surfers.  Single concave, available in round-squash or swallow tail.

models.name: Grommet
models.description: Slimmer version of the gutwagon, single to double concave. Quad+1. Slightly more volume than your standard shortboard. Available in round-squash or swallow tail.

models.name: Frank The Tank
models.description: Slight single concave in the nose that flows out to rolled v off the tail.  Classic all a rounder that will work in most conditions .  Comes standard as a 2+1 setup

models.name: Time Machine
models.description: Old school all the way!  50/50 rails with a spooned single concave in the nose that flows out to rolled belly of the tail.  This is the ultimate nose rider.

models.name: Mini Tanker
models.description: This is the frank the tank model shrunk down and compressed to a min mal shape. 7'4-8'6.
